key_insight: A multispectral metasurface combined with a hybrid CNN-ViT model can improve skin lesion classification by capturing both spectral detail and complementary local/global image features.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support faster, more accurate, and potentially portable skin cancer screening beyond standard visible-light imaging.
method: Multispectral metasurface acquires rich, noninvasive spectral information from skin lesions.
Hybrid CNN + Vision Transformer extracts local texture and global context for classification.
Attention maps highlight lesion regions to improve interpretability.
evidence_signal: Simulation-based evaluation in the abstract reports about 98% accuracy, 95% sensitivity, and 99% specificity, outperforming RGB-based and single-architecture methods.
watch_item: The results are simulation-based, so real-world clinical validation, device integration, and robustness across diverse patient populations still need confirmation.
paper_title: Intelligent Skin Cancer Detection Using a Multispectral Metasurface and a Hybrid
